title_en: Information Session on Fulbright Scholarships for Study and Research in the United States
summary: The department has announced an information session on the Fulbright scholarship for study and research in the United States. The text received contains only the title, so it does not state who should attend, when or where the session takes place, or how to register. Students who are interested should consult the original notice or contact the department office.
translation:
Notice of Information Session on the Fulbright Scholarship for Study and Research in the United States

Posted: 13 October 2026

[Only the title of this notice was provided. No body text, attachment or image content was available, so the date, time, location, eligibility and registration details of the session could not be translated. Please refer to the original notice or contact the department office.]
